# Quiz Flow & Logic Checklist: AIngielski – Core App

**Purpose**: Release-gate review of the quality of the requirements for quiz setup, word
selection, answer checking, the per-word flow, skip/abort/interruption and summary calculations.
Run this before `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-implement`.
**Created**: 2026-11-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) ·
[contracts/ui-navigation.md](../contracts/ui-navigation.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the initial value of the word-count field specified (empty, 10, or the set size)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for word-count input that is not numeric or is empty, as well as for out-of-range values? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 - Does the spec say whether quiz setup shows, before the quiz starts, how many words currently meet the "Tylko nowe" or "Trudne" criterion? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK004 - Is it specified which difficult words are chosen when more meet the ≥51% threshold than were requested (random, or the highest error ratio first)? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK005 - Does the spec say whether "Nowy quiz" opens setup pre-filled with the previous set, count and criterion, or with defaults? [Gap, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK006 - Is it specified whether the example-sentence *text* is ever shown (for example, after the answer is revealed), or whether it is audio-only throughout? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK007 - Are requirements for the answer input's keyboard behaviour (autocorrect, word suggestions, auto-capitalization) defined, given that they can alter or give away the spelling being practised? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the content of the abort confirmation (message text, consequence statement, buttons) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK009 - Does the spec say whether settings (variant, voice, skipping) are fixed at quiz start or can change mid-quiz? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the selection criterion listed among the persisted session attributes in the spec, as it is in Key Entities and the data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-071, Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK011 - Is the rounding rule for the "≥ 51%" difficulty threshold explicit (for example, whether 50.5% qualifies), or is the threshold stated as an exact fraction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the rounding mode for the quiz success percentage specified (half-up, half-even, or truncation)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK013 - Is "played" defined precisely: does it mean playback started, finished, or was the automatic playback attempted? Does it include playing only the sentence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-071]
- [x] CHK014 - Is it clear whether pressing "Pomiń" is followed by a reveal state with "Dalej", or moves straight to the next word? FR-024 says it "shows the correct word and translation before moving on". [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the word-matching normalization (case folding, whitespace) unambiguous for non-ASCII letters (for example "café", "naïve")? Is the locale used for case folding stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the "random" word order and selection requirement stated in a verifiable way (for example, uniform without replacement), rather than just "random"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK017 - Is "after the first automatic playback finishes" clear about what happens when that playback is interrupted or fails? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK018 - Do US2 scenario 7 ("When a word is presented, Then a 'Pomiń' button is visible") and the UI contract (Pomiń only in the `Answering` phase, after the first playback) agree on when skip becomes available? [Conflict, Spec §US2-7, contracts/ui-navigation.md]
- [x] CHK019 - Does FR-023 ("before and after answering") agree with the UI contract, which hides the play buttons during the first automatic playback? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, contracts/ui-navigation.md]
- [x] CHK020 - FR-028 marks all not-yet-completed words "as not played", but the word on screen when the quiz is aborted has already been played. Does FR-028 agree with the data model, where `played` stays as it was during finalization? [Conflict, Spec §FR-028, data-model.md §Session states]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the success-% formula used for aborted sessions (FR-030: correct ÷ all selected words, including auto-skipped ones) the one intended for the statistics average (FR-060)? Is it stated explicitly that aborted sessions are included in the average? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030, §FR-060]
- [x] CHK022 - Are the criterion labels consistent everywhere ("Losowe" / "Tylko nowe" / "Trudne", versus "only new words" and "difficult words" in the user stories)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §US3]
- [x] CHK023 - Do the abort rule (FR-028) and the interruption rule (FR-028a) use the same definition of "answered" (correct or incorrect only, with skips excluded)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, §FR-028a]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the behaviour of system back with skipping enabled (opens the abort confirmation, per the UI contract) reflected in the spec, which only says back "MUST NOT leave or rewind the quiz"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, §US2-9]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK025 - Does SC-002 (playback within 1 s in 95% of cases) define its measurement conditions, such as a warm or cold speech engine, the device class, and the first word versus later words? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK026 - Do acceptance scenarios cover the summary percentage with a concrete worked example (for example, 7 correct of 12 gives 58%)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US2-8, §FR-030]
- [x] CHK027 - Is there an acceptance scenario for "Trudne" when no word meets the threshold (an all-random fallback)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK028 - Is there an acceptance scenario for an interrupted quiz (the system closes the app) that states the expected stored outcome? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-028a]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for audio interruptions during the quiz (incoming call, another app taking audio focus, headphones disconnected)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK030 - Is it specified what happens to playback when the app goes to the background mid-utterance, and whether anything replays on return? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for the speech engine failing in the middle of a quiz, including whether the input field appears and whether the word can still be answered or skipped? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 - Is the case where the device's media volume is muted or zero addressed (warning or not)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK033 - Does the spec define the quiz flow when skipping is disabled and the learner cannot spell a word at all? Is a forced wrong answer the only exit, and is that intentional? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the abort action's availability in the `Revealed` phase (after answering, before "Dalej") specified in the spec, not only in the UI contract? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK035 - Are requirements defined for word entries that contain alternative forms or annotations (for example "colour/color", "to run (ran, run)", "the cat"), which an exact match would make impossible to answer correctly? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK036 - Is it addressed how US versus GB spelling differences relate to the selected English variant (for example, British voice and the CSV word "color")? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-025, §FR-040]
- [x] CHK037 - Is the boundary case "set has exactly 10 words" described for the setup range (fixed at 10–10)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK038 - Is the behaviour defined when a word set is overwritten or deleted between the end of one quiz and a "Nowy quiz" started from the summary? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-032, §FR-057]
- [x] CHK039 - Is a maximum answer length or allowed character set specified for the input field? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-022]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK040 - Are speech-rate requirements (normal or slower playback for learners) intentionally excluded from scope or missing? [Gap, Assumption]
- [x] CHK041 - Are accessibility requirements for the quiz specified, such as TalkBack announcing correct or incorrect, and reaching play buttons and the result without reading out the hidden word? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, constitution V]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK042 - Is the assumption that history is matched by set name (a renamed re-import loses its "new" and "difficult" history) explicitly accepted, with that consequence written into the spec? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK043 - Is the dependency on an installed offline English voice before a quiz may start stated as a requirement, beyond the edge-case note? [Dependency, Spec §Edge Cases, research R6]
